collection.title: Perodua Kelisa 2001 to 2007 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Perodua Kelisa 2001 - 2007 will fit, this model requires a 18" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 16" for the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade.
